headlines.headline: Publicis reports Q3 2026 net revenue organic growth of +5.0% and confirms its full-year 2026 guidance.
Omnicom reports Q2 2026 Core Operations organic revenue growth of 6.1% and an Adjusted EBITA margin of 17.8%.
Omnicom reports Q3 2026 Core Operations organic revenue growth of 7.2% and says it is on track to deliver $900 million in cost-reduction synergies in 2026.
WPP reports H1 2026 revenue less pass-through costs down 4.7% LFL and maintains its full-year headline operating margin expectation of 12% to 13%.
Havas reports Q3 2026 organic net revenue growth of +2.4% and confirms its full-year 2026 guidance.
Stagwell reports Q2 2026 organic net revenue growth of 5% and raises its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $1.03 to $1.17.

records.quote: Our marketing transformation capabilities benefited from the growing demand from clients for our AI-powered products and services, with Connected Media and Intelligent Creativity growing high-single-digit and single-digit respectively.
records.speaker: Arthur Sadoun, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: At the same time, we had a record new business run, once again placing us at the top of the rankings.
records.speaker: Arthur Sadoun, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: This was our 25th quarter of outperformance, and thanks to our unique ability to connect data, technology and talent through the Power of One, we are confident in confirming our full-year guidance for 2026 and in outperforming the market for the eighth consecutive year in 2027.
records.speaker: Arthur Sadoun, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Q3 was another very strong quarter for Publicis, with organic growth of +5%, accelerating on the first half of the year and further widening the gap with our peers.
records.speaker: Arthur Sadoun, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Looking even further ahead, the reshaping of our industry around three global players is creating favorable conditions for our future growth.
records.speaker: Arthur Sadoun, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: AI is not, at the moment, creating the kind of environment that you could say, gee, buy these four tools, that these are the people selling them and, as a result, you can cut your marketing budget by X.
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: We'll continue investing in our people and agentic technology to drive measurable business outcomes for our clients.
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: As we discussed on our February 18 earnings call, our board of directors approved a $5 billion share repurchase program. We plan to repurchase $3 billion to $3.5 billion of shares during 2026.
records.speaker: Philip Angelastro, CFO

records.quote: And since closing the acquisition, we have already won, retained and expanded substantial scopes of business, some of them you will have read about in the last two or three days.
records.speaker: Daryl Simm, President and COO

records.quote: Clients are consolidating more work with us because they see the competitive advantage our connected capabilities deliver.
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: On a combined basis, net of planned dispositions, our adjusted 2025 revenue base is $23.1 billion. In 2026, we expect this revenue base to grow approximately 4% on a constant currency basis.
records.speaker: Philip Angelastro, CFO

records.quote: Our synergy expectation is to achieve $1.5 billion in cost reductions by mid-2028, including $900 million in 2026 and $1.3 billion in 2027.
records.speaker: Philip Angelastro, CFO

records.quote: We've strengthened our competitive position and are on track to deliver $900 million in cost-reduction synergies in 2026 resulting in stronger organic revenue growth, operating margins, and earnings per share
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Our second quarter results reflect the momentum of the new Omnicom. Revenue in our Core Operations grew 6.1% organically and we had strong margin expansion
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: As we approach the one-year anniversary of the Interpublic acquisition, we continue to deliver the expected benefits of the combination.
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Our portfolio realignment was a significant first step and will result in 55% of our revenue coming from our faster-growing interconnected businesses, including media, data, CRM, consulting, and commerce.
records.speaker: Philip Angelastro, CFO

records.quote: We are built for an era where speed, integration, and scale matter most.
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: With our integration nearly complete and our portfolio of companies and operations streamlined, we're focused on high-demand services and are well positioned to pursue future growth.
records.speaker: John Wren, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: For marketing agencies that can pivot, adapt, put AI to work and offer the full breadth of integrated services, I believe there’s a once-in-a-generation growth opportunity and the new WPP is built to seize this opportunity.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: Open Intelligence, our AI-powered data layer, is being actively deployed, driving meaningful uplift in media performance for clients.
In an environment where AI is rapidly transforming our industry and trust is scarce, I believe our commitment to client data ownership and control will become increasingly important.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: We do, however, expect average net debt to remain broadly stable and note that any proceeds from asset disposals during the year will be used to strengthen our balance sheet, providing a greater degree of financial flexibility.
records.speaker: Joanne Wilson, CFO

records.quote: We are on track to deliver £100m of in-year savings in 2026 as part of the broader Elevate28 programme targeting £500m in gross annualised cost savings by 2028, unlocking capital to support reinvestment into our primary growth engines.

We continue to make progress on asset disposals and will provide updates as appropriate. Proceeds will be used to improve financial flexibility; strengthen our balance sheet and create further capacity to invest in growth.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: In fact, the impact from new business wins in 2026 already exceeds the impact of new business wins for all of 2025 combined and its only February!
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: While the turnaround of our financial performance will take time to fully flow through, our strong new business wins and improved client retention, as well as progress on cost savings and portfolio actions, demonstrate that we are building a simpler, more competitive and higher-performing WPP.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: Again, these wins demonstrate that when we show up as one WPP – media-led, data and tech-enabled, structurally integrated, with creativity at our heart – we are the growth partner of choice for the world's leading brands.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: The next phase is about building on these foundations and returning the company to growth sometime during 2027 and the third phase will be about accelerating our growth so we can capture our fair share of the market from 2028 and beyond.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: Reflecting this, while we are pleased with the first-half margin performance, as expected and in line with our planning, we nevertheless expect second-half margins to be down by as much as 200 basis points year-on-year as continued investment in growth drivers and the rebuild of incentives ramps up.
records.speaker: Joanne Wilson, CFO

records.quote: When we consider what is WPP-specific, the major negative impact to call out both for the full year and for the fourth quarter is the impact of gross client losses which deteriorated through the year.
records.speaker: Joanne Wilson, CFO

records.quote: While legacy account losses continue to weigh, Q2 saw a further sequential improvement in LFL growth, highlighting the momentum we are building across the company and demonstrating that our strategy to become the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands is beginning to deliver.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: The headline is that we’re on track with where we said we would be, stabilising the business and delivering on our ambitions with clear evidence of progress across all leading indicators.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: We have a bold plan to make WPP a simpler more integrated company, one that’s fit for the future and relentlessly focused on growth and brilliant execution.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: We are successfully transitioning from a complex holding company to a single, integrated company – with four operating units across four regions, all underpinned by WPP Open, our agentic marketing platform, which enables and connects everything we do.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: Commerce is no longer just a channel; it is the ultimate organising principle for modern marketing, with global commerce ad spend now surpassing total TV advertising.
records.speaker: Cindy Rose, CEO

records.quote: We remain firmly focused on our strategic priorities: advancing the deployment of our Converged.AI Operating System, investing responsibly in AI and preparing our talent for the continued transformation of our industry.
records.speaker: Yannick Bolloré, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Our disciplined approach to acquisitions is further strengthening the capabilities we bring to clients while supporting growth, and we will remain active in pursuing selected opportunities that support our long-term strategy.
records.speaker: Yannick Bolloré, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: This performance reflects the resilience of our client-centric model in a macroeconomic and geopolitical environment that remains uncertain. Despite this backdrop, the strength of our fundamentals, together with our ability to adapt and win new business, give us confidence in our capacity to deliver sustainable, profitable growth.
records.speaker: Yannick Bolloré, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Havas delivered a solid third quarter, achieving organic growth in net revenue of +2.4%, in line with our full-year guidance.
records.speaker: Yannick Bolloré, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: We are also continuing to bring our talent, expertise and solutions together more seamlessly across the Group, helping clients build more desirable brands and reinforcing our position as a trusted business partner.
records.speaker: Yannick Bolloré, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: As AI continues to evolve at a rapid pace, the ability to solve short-term challenges will become increasingly sophisticated and efficient. Access to information will become more uniform, and many services are likely to become commoditized.
records.speaker: Takeshi Sano, President & Global CEO

records.quote: Our second quarter results demonstrate Stagwell is thriving in today’s AI era.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: that work is getting far more efficient, because about 75% of the coding now is done agentically.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: These strong results, combined with continued share repurchases, resulted in 39% growth in adjusted EPS to $0.25.
records.speaker: Ryan Greene, CFO

records.quote: With industry-leading growth, expanding margins, and growing free cash flow, we do not believe that our current trading multiples are appropriate. To that end, we’ll continue leveraging our buyback authorization to shrink our share count further to have a positive compounding impact on our adjusted EPS growth.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Stagwell’s unique combination of software, services and engineers is being embraced by the industry leading to another record-breaking Net New Business quarter of $171 million, highlighted by recent wins with IBM, Adobe, Mondelez and Heineken
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Our pipeline has never been stronger. We expect cumulative year-end pipeline to be about 30% higher than last year.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Strong growth, combined with proactive cost management and share repurchases, means we are raising our adjusted EPS outlook for the year today, and we expect to deliver double-digit growth in the second half, the lions’ share of which will be organic.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: We are also carefully managing our costs throughout the business as we grow and expect our margins to continue expanding. This should mean solid growth and adjusted EBITDA in 2027 and then excellent growth in 2028 with the political season as well.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Our organic net revenue growth continues to accelerate, led by 18% growth in our Digital Transformation segment, and 12% growth in Communications as the political cycle starts to ramp up.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO

records.quote: Since launching our cost reduction program in April of 2025, we have actioned approximately $70 million of annualized savings and remain on track to achieve our year-end target of $80 million to $100 million.
records.speaker: Ryan Greene, CFO

records.quote: The market is increasingly moving away from commoditized IT services with thousands of low-cost engineers towards higher value work that combines business strategy, technology, creativity and AI transformation.
records.speaker: Mark Penn, Chairman and CEO
